import PV_L2C_NativeQ import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases set_option autoImplicit false namespace PV_L2C_SampleCanonical open PV_L2C_M31 PV_L2C_NativeQ /-- The literal m31 control on an arbitrary supplied raw-word stream. Failed prefixes are retained by the surrounding L2B trace laws, not assigned a law here. -/ def scan : Nat → List word → Option (word × List word) | 0,_ => none | _+1,[] => none | n+1,w::ws => let c := w &&& BitVec.ofNat 32 p if c.toNat

simp [scan] at h | succ n ih => cases xs with | nil => simp [scan] at h | cons w ws => unfold scan at h split at h · rename_i hc have he := congrArg Prod.fst (Option.some.inj h) exact he ▸ hc · exact ih ws h #print axioms scalar_canonical def tuple (a b c d : word) : Q := fun i => if i.val=0 then a else if i.val=1 then b else if i.val=2 then c else d theorem tuple_canonical (a b c d : word) (ha : canonical a) (hb : canonical b) (hc : canonical c) (hd : canonical d) : Canonical (tuple a b c d) := by intro i fin_cases i <;> simp [tuple,ha,hb,hc,hd] #print axioms tuple_canonical def sampleQ (fuel : Nat) (xs : List word) : Option (Q × List word) := do let (a,xs1) ← scan fuel xs let (b,xs2) ← scan fuel xs1 let (c,xs3) ← scan fuel xs2 let (d,xs4) ← scan fuel xs3 some (tuple a b c d,xs4) theorem secure_canonical (fuel : Nat) (xs : List word) (q : Q) (rest : List word) (h : sampleQ fuel xs=some (q,rest)) : Canonical q := by unfold sampleQ at h cases h0 : scan fuel xs with | none => simp [h0] at h | some av => rcases av with ⟨a,xs1⟩ cases h1 : scan fuel xs1 with | none => simp [h0,h1] at h | some bv => rcases bv with ⟨b,xs2⟩ cases h2 : scan fuel xs2 with | none => simp [h0,h1,h2] at h | some cv => rcases cv with ⟨c,xs3⟩ cases h3 : scan fuel xs3 with | none => simp [h0,h1,h2,h3] at h | some dv => rcases dv with ⟨d,xs4⟩ simp only [h0,h1,h2,h3,Option.bind_some,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h have he : tuple a b c d=q := h.1 rw [← he] exact tuple_canonical a b c d (scalar_canonical fuel xs a xs1 h0) (scalar_canonical fuel xs1 b xs2 h1) (scalar_canonical fuel xs2 c xs3 h2) (scalar_canonical fuel xs3 d xs4 h3) #print axioms secure_canonical end PV_L2C_SampleCanonical

import R1Z.PV_CB_Op71Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_CanonicalParser
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_CB_ShippedOp71
/-- The real scalar byte primitives, rather than a codec-success premise. -/
theorem word_roundtrip (x : U32) :
    core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x)=x := by
  simp [core.num.U32.from_le_bytes,core.num.U32.to_le_bytes]
#print axioms word_roundtrip

/-- The actual extracted native >=P branch takes its accepting arm. -/
theorem scalar_parse (x : U32) (hx : x.val<2147483647) :
    aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x)=ok (some x) := by
  have h : ¬ x≥aspis_core.field.P := by
    unfold aspis_core.field.P
    scalar_tac
  simp [aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes,word_roundtrip,h]
#print axioms scalar_parse
end PV_L2C_CanonicalParser
